title: Space Radiation

primary_sources.note: HMEC-1 endothelial cells exposed to microgravity vs space radiation (DNA repair, endothelial activation, apoptosis pathways)

affected_organ_systems.label: Immune & Hematopoietic System
affected_organ_systems.evidence_summary: Space radiation and spaceflight stressors are associated with immune dysregulation and DNA damage/repair activation.

affected_organ_systems.label: Cardiovascular & Vascular Endothelium
affected_organ_systems.evidence_summary: Radiation-stimulated endothelial activation (hypoxia, inflammation) and cardiovascular risk pathways observed in OSDR studies.

affected_organ_systems.label: Bone & Musculoskeletal System
affected_organ_systems.evidence_summary: Combined unloading and radiation exposure studied for bone and cartilage degradation risks.

observable_indicators_in_aetherion.missing_data_rule: If no dosimeter/source is attached, report NO_DATA or UNVERIFIED; never fabricate radiation dose.

limitations: Historical OSDR cellular/animal/short-LEO studies are research references, not live crew dosimetry or clinical cancer/radiation diagnosis.
